observations: The page number «51» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature «7*» on the right. L01: «und besonders» continues «Sehr bedauert aber haben wir bei unsrer Kommentierungs-Arbeit,» at the end of p. 50 (JP2 0082, L40).

L09-L14 and L18-L26: the two quotations from Burgess's translation of the Sūrya-Siddhānta (Journal of the American Oriental Society 6, 1860), set in italics in the full measure, each paragraph indented; the numbers of the verses, «43.» and «44.», upright. L11: «— four in succession.», the long dash with a space on either side.

L09-L39: the procedure of the Sūrya-Siddhānta as Burgess's commentary explains it: half the equation of the conjunction (the equation of the centre, in Suter's terms) is applied to the mean place; from that place half the equation of the apsis (the anomaly) is found and applied; from that result the whole equation of the apsis is found and applied to the original mean place, and from this last place the whole equation of the conjunction. Suter's summary, L30-L39, follows the same order.
L02: «Al-Bīrūnī» spaced; N01 gives another possible author of the «Gründe der Tafeln», «Aḥmed b. al-Muthannā», spaced, with the dot under ḥ and the macron. L03: «Ibn ʿEzrā», spaced, the ʿayn raised.

L09 and L23: a grey stain over the e of «the» and over the r of «already»; read as «the» and «already». Specks not transcribed: above the line after «planet» (L13), in the u of «Berechnung» (L27), above the t of «bestimmt» (L36).

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Kh.», «Al-Bīrūnī», «Ibn ʿEzrā», «Burgess», «Aḥmed b. al-Muthannā»; italics: «Sūrya-Siddhānta», «Shāh», the quotations, «Halbierung» and «Gleichung» (L16), «Gleichung der Konjunktion», «Gleichung des Centrums», «Gleichung der Apsis», «Gleichung der Anomalie», «wahre Länge», «Biblioth. mathem.», «Transl.».
